---
description: "Use when planning, building, or reviewing the resume screener project. Enforces phased work, small reversible changes, and validation before moving on."
---
# Resume Screener Phased Workflow

- Break work into explicit phases before implementation.
- State the current phase, the goal for that phase, and how it will be validated.
- Finish and validate the current phase before starting the next one.
- Keep each phase small and reversible.
- If a requirement is unclear, resolve only the blocker for the current phase.
- For this project, prefer a progression like discovery, data model, scoring logic, integration, and validation.
